name: Owen
label: Artist-pay skeptic, buys music directly
who: I'm a Spotify listener who gravitates to independent and jazz artists, and I buy music directly when I can afford it ([2],[13]). I follow how royalties are split and get frustrated that the money still doesn't reach the musicians much.
value_for_money: Says Spotify pays artists too little, with many getting close to nothing, while the CEO is a billionaire ([13],[10]); says they support artists more by buying music directly ([2]); says paying for Spotify should support artists ([12]).
loyalty: Keeps paying because they see the subscription as a way to support artists ([12]); says they already support artists more by buying directly ([2]), and would move further in that direction if payouts keep going to AI and stock music ([7],[15]).
pain_points: Artists paid pennies for their streams ([10],[13])
Stock music in playlists to avoid royalties ([7])
Threshold and discovery mode underpay artists ([2])
likes: Buying music directly to support artists ([2])
reasons_to_stay: They describe paying for Spotify as a way to support artists, and say paying through legitimate means matters ([12],[16]). The evidence says little more about what they like in the app itself, so their reasons to stay are mostly about artist support.
tone: Sharp and sarcastic in critique, often arguing royalty math with other posters.
